title: How To Assign Different Member Forms To Various Membership Plans
text:
## How To Assign Different Member Forms To Various Membership Plans
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000006663
It is possible to assign different forms to specific membership plans.
For example, this allows to assign different contact details forms for a business listing and a different contact details form for general website users or individuals.

## Step 1 - Identify the Member Dashboard Form and Customize it
For detailed instructions, see the following article:
How To Customize Member Dashboard Forms

## Step 2 - Assign the Customized Form to a Specific Membership Plan
Now that the custom form has been created, it can be assigned to the desired membership plan.
To accomplish this, navigate to Finance >> Membership Plans >> Click " Edit " for the desired membership plan:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12108317147/original/Abu-_k-Kn58A6HY0MpGQIP3A5oZxQewllg.png?1651241754 | alt: ]
Under Member Dashboard tab, select the customized form from the appropriate dropdown:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12108317387/original/24GLTqwGm_NCUVIGcScmKpa21spruDa-QA.png?1651241986 | alt: ]
Important Note: The word 'Listing' must be included in the form name for it to appear in the dropdown options above.
